## Introduction
I want to extract information from all `README.Rmd` files to plot a graph
of what folders depend on what others. This should be automatic and always
updated every time it is re-run. Ideally, the same script will work in
other projects' folders.

Because this is in the main folder, and I want to keep it clean, I will
not save any intermediate files.

The goal of this plots is to guide the revision of the project's folder
itself: to identify redundant or deprecated folders, and those that need
updating after a change, and also to make titles more descriptive.

```{bash data}
bin/MakeProjectGraph.sh | sort | uniq -c | \
gawk '{print $3 "\t" $2 "\t" $1}' > connections.txt

ls -1 results > folders.txt

if [ -e titles.txt ]; then rm titles.txt; fi
for folder in $(ls -1 results); do
   if [ -e results/$folder/README.Rmd ]; then
      TITLE=$(grep "^title:" results/$folder/README.Rmd | sed 's/title: //')
      echo -e $folder "\t" $TITLE >> titles.txt
   else
      echo -e $folder "\tNA" >> titles.txt
   fi
done
```

## Fabric plot

```{r graf, fig.width=12, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(ggplot2)
links <- read.table('connections.txt',
                    col.names = c('from', 'to', 'weight'))
links <- links[links$from != links$to,]
nodes <- read.table('folders.txt', col.names = 'ID')
nodes <- nodes[order(nodes$ID), , drop=FALSE]
title <- read.table('titles.txt', row.names = 1, col.names = c('ID', 'title'))
nodes$title <- title[nodes$ID, 'title']
# Some folders may call input from deleted, wrong or not-pulled folders:
ghosts <- setdiff(links$from, nodes$ID)
if (length(ghosts) > 0) {
   nodes <- data.frame(ID = sort(c(nodes$ID, ghosts)))
   nodes$ghost <- nodes$ID %in% ghosts
   nodes$title <- title[nodes$ID, 'title']
   links$ghost <- links$from %in% ghosts
}
g <- graph_from_data_frame(d = links, vertices = nodes)
ggraph(g, layout = 'fabric', sort.by = name) + 
  geom_node_range(color = 'gray', aes(x=0, xend=50)) +
  geom_edge_span(end_shape = 'square', aes(edge_colour = ghost)) + 
  xlim(-35, 50) +
  geom_node_label(aes(label = title, x = -9), size = 2, hjust = 1) +
  geom_node_label(aes(label = name, x = -1), size = 2, hjust = 1) +
  coord_fixed() + theme(legend.position = 'none') +
  ggtitle("Fabric plot of the project's folders")
```

Unfortunately, I didn't manage to make the figure any wider. The folder's
name is preceded by the title of its `README.Rmd` file, if present. Folders
in blue seem to appear as sources, but are absent in the directory.
I need to fix that.

## Linear layout with archs

```{r linear, fig.width=12}
ggraph(g, layout = 'linear', sort.by = name) +
  geom_edge_arc(arrow = arrow(type = 'closed', angle = 10,
                              length=unit(0.1, 'inches')),
                color = 'orange', strength = 0.5, fold = TRUE) +
  geom_node_label(aes(label = name), angle = -45, y = -0.2,
                  nudge_x = 1, hjust = 0) +
  ylim(-4, 10) +
  theme_void()
```

```{r oneMore, fig.height=10, warning=FALSE}
N <- length(V(g))
ggraph(g, layout = data.frame(x = rep(10.1, N), y = N:1)) +
  geom_edge_arc(aes(color = weight), strength = 0.5,
                arrow = arrow(angle = 10,
                              length = unit(0.1, 'inches'),
                              type = 'closed'),
                fold = TRUE)+
  geom_node_label(aes(label = title), x = 6, hjust = 1) +
  geom_node_label(aes(label = name), x = 10, hjust = 1) +
  xlim(-5, 20) + theme(legend.position = 'none')
```

```{bash cleaning, eval=FALSE}
rm connections.txt
rm folders.txt
rm titles.txt
```
